implementation: MCP source extraction only; observer reads existing logs in a separate process. No stage-driven execution.
candidate_commit: Resolved and frozen in freeze.json before launch.
attempt_policy: One attempt per case; no retries or replacement of failures. Freeze all policy sources and bank throughout. Stop only at user request or infrastructure/integrity problem.

acceptance.interpretation: Engineering recovery criterion; not a statistical equivalence claim. Report paired cases and all-attempt costs; known benchmark, not unseen heldout.

monitoring: Separate read-only interaction_monitor process; it never enters the agent workspace or model context.
